title: ECHS Dehradun Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 15 Pharmacist, Medical Officer and Other Posts
description: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 15 Medical Specialists, Medical Officers, Pharmacists, Housekeepers, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, MD/ MS, B.Sc, DMLT, B.Pharm, or any degree, or are 10th pass, can use this chance and apply for the ECHS Dehradun Notification 2026 .
